roles.role_goal: hold contested space and absorb direct attention
protect an actor, route, objective, or zone
apply pressure through movement, disengagement, and repeated repositioning
project threat at range from constrained or advantageous positions
shape choices through existing denial, terrain, or control effects
improve allies through existing recovery, enhancement, information, or coordination
convert concealment, surprise, or reveal timing into a brief advantage
maintain contact with a moving quarry and punish disengagement
create repeated low-commitment interference that taxes attention or resources
threaten from distance through accuracy, concealment, or prepared lines
interrupt plans using existing denial, counteraction, interference, or displacement
change encounter tempo through governed arrivals, summons, or reserve actors
coordinate allies using existing command, morale, information, or support capabilities
interpose for or escort a protected actor
anchor pressure around a location, object, system, or task
interact with existing environmental systems or hazards as part of encounter pressure
acquire, relay, or deny information while avoiding direct commitment
bypass, penetrate, sabotage, or reach objectives using existing access tools
serve as the primary encounter focus using only the source's existing action, defense, movement, and phase structure
operate as a complementary two-actor package using existing synergies without inventing combo mechanics

intents: Emphasize the role by prioritizing already-supported capabilities, targets, positions, or encounter responsibilities that serve {role_goal}.
Expose source-supported counterplay by telegraphing limitations, dependencies, access conditions, or alternative responses around {role_goal}.
Shift starting position, route, range band, cover relationship, adjacency, or objective placement so existing capabilities express {role_goal} differently.
Shift when existing capabilities, arrivals, reveals, or commitments occur without adding actions, powers, phases, or recharge rules.
Redistribute quantity, waves, pairings, reserves, or encounter responsibilities among already-governed actors to express {role_goal} without altering their source mechanics.
Add or clarify retreat, bypass, surrender, disengagement, rescue, partial-success, or objective alternatives so role pressure does not require a forced defeat outcome.

allowed_adjustment_surfaces: timing of already-authorized arrivals or commitments
verification_questions: Which exact source capabilities support this role assignment?
Which proposed change is encounter composition/presentation rather than a new creature mechanic?
What becomes not applicable if the required source capability is absent?
Which GCL-07 pressure dimensions materially change and what tradeoff is introduced?
counterplay_prompts: identify at least one source-supported limitation, dependency, route, timing window, negotiation/bypass, or other counterplay when applicable
preserve failure-path alternatives when encounter structure supports them
shared_record_fields.not_applicable_rule: If the source lacks the required capability or authority for the proposed surface, return not_applicable rather than inventing a substitute.
shared_record_fields.provenance_rule: Every applied kit binds exact source actor/version and governing mechanic references; unknown or contradictory mechanics remain unresolved.

materialization_rule: For each role in listed order and each intent in listed order, materialize one record. ID = GCL08-{role index 02d}-{intent index 02d}. Substitute {role_goal}. Role-kit application is not_applicable unless exact source capabilities support the role and adjustment surface.
